metadata.description: Rebuild a building from one photograph as a procedural, measured Three.js model

plugins.name: photo-to-threejs-building
plugins.description: Measurement-first single-photo building reconstruction: the method as a skill (measure, solve the camera, build, score against the photograph's own pixels) plus the MCP server with its deterministic instruments (view_crop, trace_edge, solve_camera, measure_pitch, compare_images, score_render, auto-scoring workspace, inline viewer panel). The skill governs, the tools execute — installing this plugin wires BOTH.
